acp.text:
Swarm started for the static unit-converter page with all helpers running in `inherit` workspace mode:

- **html-writer**: writing `index.html` (form with two inputs, `km-to-miles` / `celsius-to-fahrenheit` select, linking `style.css` and `convert.js`)
- **css-writer**: writing `style.css` (simple readable layout)
- **logic-writer**: writing `convert.js` (`kmToMiles`, `celsiusToFahrenheit`, and form wiring)
- **docs-writer**: writing `README.md` (instructions on how to open the page)
- **verifier**: waiting for all four helpers, checking every file/reference/function, requesting fixes from owners if needed, and reporting back once all checks pass
- **monitor**: watching for stalls

I'll report back as soon as `verifier` finishes.

Run /swarm board (default shortcut alt+s) to open the live board.
